TOOLING BURST T1a-walk — walk oracle instrument on Muybridge (SPEC § 6 row "T1a-walk"). task_id "T1a-walk".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 6 rows "T1a-idle" (already built — reuse its conventions) and "T1a-walk" (your whole contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md
3. astra_test_01/burst/oracle/{motion_map.py, idle_curves.py, idle_bands.py}, gates/{common.py, matte.py, g6_seam.py, README.md}, tests/test_oracle_idle.py, tests/gates_helpers.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY.

BUILD exactly the SPEC row: oracle/walk_landmarks.py, oracle/walk_curves.py, oracle/walk_bands.py (CLI), tests/test_oracle_walk.py with the contracted cases. Then RUN on the real inputs and report the numbers in the receipt concerns:
  (a) --ref "/Users/admin/Desktop/Astra Burst Review - 2026-09-11/05 Oracle - Muybridge plate 2 (walk)/_frames" --pattern '[0-9][0-9].png' --fps 8.33 --label plate2_lateral --out oracle/bands_walk.json --plot_dir runs/C-1/oracle/plots
  (b) --ref "/Users/admin/Desktop/Astra Burst Review - 2026-09-11/05b Oracle - Muybridge plate 13 (woman walking)/_frames" --pattern 'lateral_*.png' --fps 8.33 --label plate13_lateral --out oracle/bands_walk.json --plot_dir runs/C-1/oracle/plots
  (c) --ref "/Users/admin/Desktop/Astra Burst Review - 2026-09-11/05b Oracle - Muybridge plate 13 (woman walking)/_frames" --pattern 'front_*.png' --fps 8.33 --label plate13_front --out oracle/bands_walk.json --plot_dir runs/C-1/oracle/plots
  (d) --ref "/Users/admin/Desktop/Astra Burst Review - 2026-09-11/05b Oracle - Muybridge plate 13 (woman walking)/_frames" --pattern 'rear_*.png' --fps 8.33 --label plate13_rear --out oracle/bands_walk.json --plot_dir runs/C-1/oracle/plots
Muybridge plates are PUBLIC DOMAIN — plots may be written under runs/C-1/oracle/plots/. Each cell is one phase of a 12-phase stride; frame order = the printed order. The backdrop is a printed grid: the mask must not include grid lines (report mask area / H per frame so a grid leak is visible). If the head top is unreliable on a plate (dark hair on dark backdrop), say so per frame with the head_top_thin flag and report both head_top_y and head_ref_y series. Front/rear rows: bob, W-3 head path and W-4 are meaningful; W-5/W-6 and sole scroll are NOT (say null, do not fake them).
Then run the FULL suite: `cd astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected all green except the four named T0-d3 reds — do not touch them; report exact counts.

DO NOT touch: lane/, oracles/, parts/, transcribe/, compare/, bible/, gates/ (read only), the T1a-idle modules (read only; add new modules), SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, briefs/, fixtures/. Under runs/ write ONLY runs/C-1/oracle/. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under tests/tmp/.

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T1a-walk"): files = every created/modified file with sha256 (absolute paths under astra_test_01/burst); images []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns must name precisely anything not met, with numbers, AND carry the measured summary per plate row (W-1 %H, W-2 phase of min/max, W-3a/b/c, W-4, W-5 per arm, W-6, planted-sole scroll px/frame + slip; the 12-frame phase table). Never PASS/FAIL.
